page.empty.saved.title: Saving replays
page.empty.saved.body: The star by a game's portrait saves it here.
page.empty.imported.title: Importing replays
page.empty.imported.body: Import shared replays or a Power.log, or paste them here with Ctrl+V.
options.title: Replay Settings
options.noAskRemove: Don't ask when removing saved or imported replays
options.noAskDelete: Don't ask when deleting saved replays
options.tip.title: Don't ask when deleting
options.tip.body: Unstarring a saved replay that is no longer among your recent replays, while those are full, deletes it for good. With this on, that happens without asking. Needs the box above.
options.keepFewer.title: Keep fewer replays?
options.keepFewer.body: |4(The oldest replay will be deleted.,The {0} oldest replays will be deleted.)
popup.removeImported.title: Remove from imported?
popup.removeImported.starred: The replay will be removed from your imported replays. Its starred copy stays in your saved replays.
popup.removeImported.body: The replay will be deleted from your imported replays.
popup.unsave.title: Remove from saved?
popup.unsave.staysRecent: The saved copy will be removed. The game stays in your recent replays.
popup.unsave.staysImported: The saved copy will be removed. The game stays in your imported replays.
popup.unsave.backToImported: The replay will be moved back to your imported replays.
popup.unsave.backToRecent: The replay will be moved back to your recent replays.
popup.deleteReplay.title: Delete this replay?
popup.deleteReplay.body: Your recent replays are full ({0} |4(game,games)), so this replay will be deleted.
folder.pick.description: Choose a folder for your Hearthstone replays (outside the Hearthstone folder).
folder.pick.message: A folder window has opened (it may be behind the game). Choose a folder for your replays: recent, saved and imported games are kept there, about 1 MB each.
folder.another.title: Choose another folder
folder.another.insideHs: That folder is inside the Hearthstone folder, which game updates and repairs can clear. Please choose a folder outside it.
folder.another.recent: That is where the recent replays are kept. Please choose another folder.
folder.another.logs: That is where converted Power.log games wait to be imported. Please choose another folder.
import.dialog.title: Import Hearthstone replays
import.dialog.message: A file window has opened (it may be behind the game). Please choose the replays to import: replay files others shared, or a Power.log.
import.paste.nothing: Copy a replay file first (in Explorer), then paste it here
import.paste.notReplays: The copied files aren't replays or Power.log files

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.body:
This opens a new issue on GitHub with your versions and PC details filled in.

The screenshot is copied: press Ctrl+V in the issue to add it. Drag the files from the folder that opens {0} into the issue too, and say what went wrong.
